//: OPTIONAL. Nothing in this repository needs a compiler - the browser and node
both load src/**/*.js as written. This file exists so `npm run typecheck` can
still read the JSDoc on the public surface and catch a typo or a wrong arity.
`strict` is off deliberately. With checkJs and strict together, every one of
the 7,600 lines that used to carry an inline annotation reports an implicit
any, and a check that reports 2,000 things reports nothing. What is left still
catches the mistakes that actually happen here: a misspelled property, a call
with the wrong number of arguments, a typedef that has drifted from its call.
